title: BDLB Item
description: Output contract for the BDLB question-author. One JSON per authored item. Extends the STAAR item schema (inlined, not $ref'd) and adds BDLB-specific fields: tier, var_id, variation_basis.

tier.description: BDLB tier this item belongs to. REQUIRED.

var_id.description: Variation id within the tier (v00..v19). REQUIRED.

numbers.description: Concrete numeric values used to instantiate this variation.

context_seed.description: Short label identifying the contextual setting (e.g. 'pencils_box', 'apples_basket').

variation_basis.description: Programmatic basis used by tier-specifier to guarantee uniqueness. REQUIRED.

item_type.description: BDLB item type. Free-form string per tier_spec (e.g. 'mcq_4', 'text_entry').

options.description: Multiple-choice options. Exactly 4 strings if present.

correct_option_index.description: Index into options of the correct answer. Required when options is present.

image_ref.description: Relative path to a PNG under bdlb/runs/{run_id}/images/, or null if no image.

final_answer.description: Canonical final answer as a string.

steps.description: Worked solution steps suitable for a teacher rationale.

tek_alignment.description: TEK code or alignment string this item maps to.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this item was authored.

qc_status.description: Current QC status of this item. REQUIRED; writer sets default.

tek_code.description: Optional STAAR-style TEK code (inlined from STAAR schema for compatibility).

reporting_category.description: Optional STAAR reporting category (inlined for compatibility).

difficulty.description: Optional STAAR difficulty mirror of tier (inlined for compatibility).

calculator_allowed.description: Optional STAAR calculator flag (inlined for compatibility).

explanation.description: Optional teacher-facing explanation (inlined from STAAR schema).

alignment_evidence.description: Optional alignment evidence block (inlined from STAAR schema).

allOf.description: If options are present, correct_option_index is required.
